title: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker: Halloween House

lines.text: Which Halloween house would you survive in?
lines.caption: Which ^Halloween house would *you survive in?

lines.text: The noob built a dirt box...
lines.caption: The #noob built a dirt box...

lines.text: and forgot to carve the pumpkin.
lines.caption: and forgot to carve the ^pumpkin.

lines.text: The pro built a haunted cottage...
lines.caption: The $pro built a haunted cottage...

lines.text: But the hacker typed one command...
lines.caption: But the !hacker typed !one command...

lines.text: and built a house inside a giant pumpkin.
lines.caption: and built a house *inside a ^giant ^pumpkin.

lines.text: So which one are you picking?
